title: Edit layout rebuilt: every flow
sub: One panel on the right, the same as the Farm view's: what you are on, what is inside, then the actions, with Delete alone at the end. Every step is a page in that panel with Cancel and the next step at the bottom. The map is only for placing: the panel steps aside and a guide names the task. The camera keeps the same margins, so opening a page never moves it. Beside a narrow chat the panel becomes a bottom sheet.
sections: The bar ran into the room card: Delete sat on the room title
Undo and redo sat on Delete
Add pens: a sentence squeezed into a small card
A new pen type: choices as chips in a popover
Every Add works like Add room: choose it, the pointer carries a green box (a device carries its icon), click to put it down, then its details. One guide, one wording.
Lane: the box snaps to where the next lane goes
Placed: the lane opens with its pens
Row: the box goes to the end your pointer is nearer
Placed at the far end: only the pens are asked
Device: the pointer becomes its icon
Add a zone, step by step
Add zone: its outline follows the pointer
Clicked: the name page opens, the outline stays
Add a section, then a room
Add section: place it in the zone
The name page opens straight away, with its size
A lane: its pens from the door, steppers to change them
Add pens › Pen type: a list, not a popover
New pen type, step 1: what it is
Back on Add pens with the new type picked
Add device: grouped, each with one line on what it does
A feeder: click the lane, the whole lane is ticked; click pens to change it
Set up: device code, model, what it connects to
A door picked: the panel is about the door
Rooms picked: what you can do with them
The panel becomes a bottom sheet; the lane stays in view above it
Farm view: Schedule replaces Batches, scoped to where you are
The farm: every batch, then Health and Other
Gestation 2: only its treatment and its move
Pen A3: only what touches that pen. No Pigs pill in a pen
A task row opens its record: the running treatment
